description:
Long term contract with one of the leading Telecommunications providers in Atlanta.  We are looking for expert developers, but specifically those with experience with Oracle Fusion Middleware Development.  Please apply today! 
 
 
 • 7+ years of experience in implementation of large scale Middleware Applications 

 • Experience with Middleware, such as Oracle Fusion Middleware (e.g., SOA Suite 10g/11g, OSB, ODI, BPEL, ESB, OSM), Weblogic Middleware Product Stack. 
 • Preferred Experience with AIA PIPs, AIA Concept, AIA Foundation Pack
 • Experience with Web Service and XML technologies, such as WSDL, SOAP, XSLT, XQuery, XSD, XPath
 • Experience with Messaging, such as Java Messaging Service (JMS)
 • Experience with version control tools
 • Experience with integrating applications with business and partner applications, preferably through a Service Orientated Architecture (SOA) solution
 • Experience with appropriate programming languages and tools (e.g., Java and PL/SQL

 Required Experience:
 • 7+ Years Experience Oracle Fusion Middleware Development
 • Experienced in supporting & troubleshoot production issues as they happen 
 • Experience in performing Research on the root cause analysis and providing solutions for resolution.
 • Excellent communication skills – verbally & written

 I will be interviewing this week, please apply today!
